caption: The drawing depicts a bust sculpture of a man, shown from the chest up, against a plain, light beige background. The sculpture represents a man dressed in formal attire, featuring a high-collared shirt, a cravat, a double-breasted coat with wide lapels, and curls in his hair. The entire bust has a distinct wood texture, with visible grain and carved lines that give the appearance of a wooden object. The coloration consists mainly of light brown tones, mimicking natural wood, with some blueish-green patches on the shoulders and the lower part of the bust, suggesting areas of aged paint or patina. The facial expression shows neutral features, and the overall composition is centered, with the bust angled slightly to the right.
title: Figurehead
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
